statements.impact_statement: CVE-2024-3205 reported a heap buffer overflow in yaml_emitter_emit_flow_sequence_item() (src/emitter.c) of libyaml 0.2.5, found by the OSS-Fuzz libyaml_dumper_fuzzer. The CVE has been rejected: it was withdrawn by its CNA because further investigation showed it was not a security issue; the maintainer identified an error in the libyaml fuzzers, and the issue cannot be reproduced or exploited (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-3205). The maintainer's analysis: the fuzzer's write handler returns 0 on success, which libyaml treats as a write failure, and the fuzzer then calls yaml_emitter_close() after yaml_emitter_dump() has already failed, using an emitter left in an error state; the overflow comes from that misuse in the calling program (https://github.com/yaml/libyaml/issues/258#issuecomment-2058613931, https://github.com/yaml/libyaml/issues/289). The DHI libyaml packages are built from Debian's libyaml 0.2.5-2 source, which carries no Debian patches and is unmodified upstream 0.2.5, the code the maintainer reviewed.
